disclaimer.volunteer.title: Volunteer Project
disclaimer.volunteer.body: Calmatic Suite is a completely free, volunteer-driven, open-source project. It is built and maintained by contributors in their own time, with no commercial interest. There are no ads, no subscriptions, and no data collection.
disclaimer.volunteer.openSource: Contributions, bug reports, and suggestions are welcome. The project is open source and available on GitHub.
